notes: *that* before *ruled* is the attributive article's under rule 41, a present morpheme taking its English before rule 46's supplied-relative reading does.
The copula *were* of the causal clause goes to the predicate גִּבּוֹרֵי with its supplied generic *men*, the explicit pronoun keeping only *they* (rules 20, 31, 46).
*were ... born* is discontinuous around the subject noun under rule 25 and heads on the lexical verb.
